summary: One medium finding: the previously confirmed generic-to-quaternionic algebraic-forms ownership bridge remains absent from RS-23. The four narrowings conserve their targets, the 14 links are live and acyclic, and the current M5/M6 consumer corrections hold.
checked: Complete accepted RS-23 proposal, author report, independent review, both member documents and their 20 stage decisions, all 20 evidence rows (ten mirrored pairs), nine owner records and 14 links.

Target conservation for H0, H1, M5 and M6 against their full member text and reviewed library-audit targets; relevant M0-M4, H2/H4 and R18.2 audit rows for the general/special and good-prime/ramified boundaries.

ShimuraData document, especially D4/D5; A5 genus-one analytic comparison; all 13 distinct immediate consumers of the four narrowed layers, including four current unitary-example consumers and six arithmetic/Hodge-line consumers.

Explicit requests to the changed layers in FaltingsFinitenessAndIsogenyTheorems and ShimuraCompactifications--C6 packets; the consumer-specific descent and cusp-lattice obligations remain with their application owners.

Fresh atlas assembly at the input commit: 2907 stage records, 8322 stage edges, 2958 graph endpoint vertices; all 14 RS-23 links present, all identifiers valid, no deferred proposal links, full graph acyclic. Every consumer has a supplier path avoiding the corresponding narrowed stage; the four unitary consumers use the retained M5 output.

Accepted restructuring interactions on member stages, especially RS-02 analytic genus-one inputs, RS-06 M6 family/Hodge-line exports and RS-14 M5 unitary consumers; M5 is no longer a sink, and the corrected JSON, not the stale author-report sink argument, was tested.

Pinned Mathlib Submodule.traceDual, Submodule.mem_traceDual and FractionalIdeal.dual in RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Different.lean, including the actual scalar-tower, integral-closure, finite-dimensionality and separability assumptions. No trace-dual replacement or advanced library-absence assertion is made.

Birkbeck-Heuer-Williams published primary PDF, section 5.1, printed pages 1740-1745 (PDF indices 32-37); visual inspection of printed page 1743, equations (5.1)-(5.2) and the similitude condition. This checks the polarization/trace/level scope, not the entire paper or its cited representability proofs.

Cross-family audit leads for R18.3: confirmed RT-AREA-automorphic-1/31 remains a missing supplier bridge; the proposed current AF.5 -> R18.3 repair is acyclic. RT-AREA-langlands-2/19 and its fixes distinguish Galois-free freeness from later control; RS-23 retaining the former is correct.
No Tau Ceti roadmap/layer is changed and no upstream-to-upstream edge is proposed; no upstream finding or source erratum is asserted.

findings.claim: The accepted proposal retains the generic coefficient-function-space, Hecke and level-change construction in R18.3 without assigning it the existing general automorphic-forms supplier. AF.5 still plans the algebraic-modular-form/finite-double-coset dictionary and the live graph gives R18.3 no path from it. The quaternionic specialization, integral stabilizer calculations, Taylor-Wiles freeness, dyadic twists and Jacquet-Langlands comparison must remain; the missing boundary is the reusable generic API. This is the still-unapplied RS-23 portion of confirmed RT-AREA-automorphic-1/31, not a new discovery of that overlap.
findings.evidence: RS-23 R18.3 reason says "Keep definite quaternionic forms on actual finite double-coset sets, their coefficient and Hecke operations". The member README R18.3 says "Define algebraic automorphic forms on the finite double-coset set with their weight module and integral coefficients" and then asks for Hecke action and change of level. AutomorphicFormsOnReductiveGroups README AF.4 supplies algebraic coefficient systems with lattices; AF.5 says "Identify algebraic modular forms on compact-at-infinity groups with functions on finite adelic double cosets valued in an algebraic representation". The reviewed library-coverage R18.3 duplicate entry names AF.5. RT-AREA-automorphic-1.review.json confirms /31 specifically as a missing generic-to-quaternionic ownership bridge. Its fixes report /31 item 5 expressly requests an RS-23 correction. At c11b1ea929634cf2e497111b56517d9c6dd474e0, no such owner or link occurs, AF.5:algebraic-forms is not a live stage, and the current AF.5 -> R18.3 edge is absent.
findings.fix: Narrow R18.3 explicitly to the quaternionic specialization, class-set/stabilizer calculations, source-specific integral freeness and dyadic tests, and the GL2/Jacquet-Langlands comparison. Give the generic coefficient, Hecke and level-change API one named AF owner and add its supplier/forwarding link. The existing AF.5 -> R18.3 link is acyclic and can be used with an exact prefix contract; the earlier fix instead proposes a new AF.5:algebraic-forms prefix depending on AF.4. If using that split, coordinate creation/promotion of the prefix and its AF.4/AF.5 links before claiming it is available. Add the owner record and update the report; do not move all AF.5 or remove the genuine quaternionic and Taylor-Wiles theorems. Apply only through the authorized restructuring/blueprint workflow.
